onboardingWelcome.subject: Welcome to Recruitment Studio
onboardingWelcome.body:
Dear {{recipientName}},

Welcome to Recruitment Studio. Your account is now active and ready to use.

You can now sign in and begin exploring programs, events, and assessments.

Warm regards,
Team Recruitment Studio

onboardingActivation.subject: Your Recruitment Studio account has been provisioned
onboardingActivation.body:
Dear {{recipientName}},

Your Recruitment Studio account has been provisioned for {{tenantName}}.

Please complete your profile after sign-in to activate all workflows.

Warm regards,
Team Recruitment Studio

managedUserWelcome.subject: Welcome to Recruitment Studio
managedUserWelcome.body:
Dear {{recipientName}},

An account has been created for you on Recruitment Studio.

Please sign in and complete your profile setup to get started.

Warm regards,
Team Recruitment Studio

assignmentCreated.subject: New {{activityType}} assigned to you
assignmentCreated.body:
Dear {{recipientName}},

{{assignerName}} has assigned a new {{activityType}} to you: {{activityTitle}}.

Please sign in to Recruitment Studio to review and complete it.

Warm regards,
Team Recruitment Studio

assignmentAssessmentReminder.subject: Reminder: please complete your assigned assessment
assignmentAssessmentReminder.body:
Dear {{recipientName}},

{{assignerName}} is reminding you to complete your assigned assessment: {{activityTitle}}.

Please sign in to Recruitment Studio and complete it at the earliest.

Warm regards,
Team Recruitment Studio

assignmentInProgress.subject: {{activityType}} marked in progress
assignmentInProgress.body:
Dear {{recipientName}},

Your {{activityType}} has moved to in-progress status: {{activityTitle}}.

Please continue and submit your completion when ready.

Warm regards,
Team Recruitment Studio

assignmentCompleted.subject: {{activityType}} completed
assignmentCompleted.body:
Dear {{recipientName}},

Your {{activityType}} has been marked as completed: {{activityTitle}}.

Thank you for completing the assigned activity.

Warm regards,
Team Recruitment Studio

assignmentCancelled.subject: {{activityType}} assignment cancelled
assignmentCancelled.body:

The assigned {{activityType}} has been cancelled: {{activityTitle}}.

No further action is required from your side for this assignment.

Warm regards,
Team Recruitment Studio

cohortMemberAdded.body:

Warm regards,
Team Recruitment Studio

cohortMemberRemoved.subject: You were removed from cohort {{cohortName}}
cohortMemberRemoved.body:

If this was unexpected, please contact your administrator.

Warm regards,
Team Recruitment Studio
